title: Affine local eventual vanishing of ideal-power evaluation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\iota:\mathcal I\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ a monomorphism of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $\mathcal I$ quasi-coherent and of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $P_n=\mathcal I^n$ with inclusion $j_n:P_n\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ and $P_0=\mathcal O_X$, using the recursive ideal powers of [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. Let $\mathcal F$ be quasi-coherent. Let $U\subseteq X$ be open with $x\in U$ if and only if $\iota_x$ is surjective. Fix sections $1_n\in P_n(U)$ with $j_n(1_n)=1$ and maps $r_{nm}:P_m\to P_n$ for $n\le m$ with $j_n r_{nm}=j_m$. For every $n$ and $\varphi:P_n\to\mathcal F$ such that $\varphi_U(1_n)=0$, for every affine open $V\subseteq X$ there are $m\ge n$ with $(\varphi r_{nm})|_V=0$. The ambient scheme need not be quasi-compact.

source.place: Lemma 01PM, proof of injectivity of the first arrow; Lemma 01PQ, first proof paragraph. Source text read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ.

proof.text: On the chosen affine open V identify the quasi-coherent ideal and module with their affine section modules, and P_n with the nth power of a finitely generated ideal J. No finite cover is chosen here. The general monic quasi-coherent structure-module subobject must be treated via its affine section image; the existing ideal-times statement is directly stated for IdealSheafData, so an identification with that model is required.

source.place: Lemma 01PQ (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open), proof; Lemma 01PM (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open-in-affine), proof. Source text read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM.

proof.text: For generators f_i of J, evaluation on D(f_i) is phi(f_i^n)/f_i^n. Vanishing and the localization zero criterion give a common k with phi(f_i^(n+k))=0 for all i. A sufficiently high degree monomial contains one of these pure powers, so phi vanishes on a higher ideal power. For the zero ideal take a positive power directly.

source.place: Lemma 01PQ (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open), proof; Lemma 01PM (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open-in-affine), proof. Source text read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM.

proof.text: After the affine algebra calculation kills a power J^m with m at least n, identify the prescribed r with the ideal-power inclusion by monicity. The affine tilde/Gamma equivalence turns the zero linear map into the zero sheaf morphism over V. This concerns only one affine open and uses no quasi-compactness of the ambient scheme.

from.place: Affine calculation in steps 1 and 2 of lem-weil-pbc-ideal-power-evaluation-eventually-zero, separated from the finite-cover globalization.

lean.statement:
theorem ideal_power_evaluation_affine_eventually_zero
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.Modules}
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono ι]
    [I.IsQuasicoherent] [I.IsFiniteType]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens) (one : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, U))
    (r : ∀ (n m : ℕ), n ≤ m →
      ((idealSheafPower ι m).1 ⟶ (idealSheafPower ι n).1))
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom)
    (hone : ∀ n : ℕ, (idealSheafPower ι n).2.app U (one n) = (1 : Γ(X, U)))
    (hr : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      r n m h ≫ (idealSheafPower ι n).2 = (idealSheafPower ι m).2) :
    ∀ (V : X.affineOpens) (n : ℕ) (φ : (idealSheafPower ι n).1 ⟶ F),
      φ.app U (one n) = 0 →
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m), (r n m h ≫ φ).over V.1 = 0
